notes: Coverage checked: twelve morphemes in ten units, sixteen targets each placed once.

Flagged large-source-unit (3 morphemes) checked and retained: in le-ma'lah the preposition, the noun and the directive he are all carried by the single adverb *upward* — no English word answers to the preposition apart from the noun, none to the he apart from the noun, and none to the noun apart from the preposition — so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met on the terms rules 32 and 40 state, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme.

The italic *goeth* is taken as the linking verb the construction hands to the whole directional predicate under rules 20 and 49 rather than as an `added` lexical verb; the competing reading is named in the unit note and the italic decides neither side, by rule 7.
